svg.title: Heegaard surface atlas · genus 3
svg.desc: A sphere with 6 holes, joined by 3 annuli. Red alpha cores cross blue/green beta curves at the signed black points. Open points mark chart attachments. No projection crossings.
svg.text: The outside continues through ∞. Dashed circles attach to the annuli.
